title: Entity node
description: One row per canonical entity (deduplicated across all documents it was found in). Covers all node types except Document/ReferenceArchitecture (document.schema.json) and Source (source.schema.json): SAPProduct, SAPService, DeveloperTool, Capability, Agent, Protocol, API, DataSource, IdentitySecurity, UseCase, Requirement, Constraint, Diagram, TechnologyDomain.

canonical_id.description: Matched entry from config/ontology.yaml canonical_entities, if any.

found_in_documents.description: node_id of every Document this entity was found in (e.g. ['doc:76ec36', 'doc:98efa0']), in first-seen order. A canonical entity is created once and this list grows every time it is re-encountered in another document - it is never overwritten or limited to the first sighting.

source_section.description: Markdown heading (## ...) the evidence was found under. null is reserved for facts with no body-text location at all (front_matter_tag entities such as TechnologyDomain). Any evidence taken from the document BODY that precedes the first level 2-4 heading must use the literal string '__introduction__' instead of null (see config/ontology.yaml introduction_section_marker).
